subject: general
question: Who among the following led the Salt Satyagraha march from Trichy to Vedaranyam in Tamil Nadu?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chakravarti Rajgopalachari.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chakravarti Rajgopalachari** led the Salt Satyagraha march from **Trichy** to **Vedaranyam** in Tamil Nadu.
 
• C. Rajgopalachari began his march from Trichy on **April 13** and reached Vedaranyam on **April 28**.
 
• Inspired by **Mahatma Gandhi's Dandi March**, a group of 100 men extracted salt from seawater at Vedaranyam in April 1930, **to break the salt law imposed by the British**.
 
• The Salt Satyagraha was an act of the **Civil Disobedience Act** led by **Mahatma Gandhi** to protest British rule in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sundara Sastri Satyamurti**, commonly known as S. Satyamurti, was a well-known Indian freedom fighter and a reputed political leader.
 
• **Kumaraswami Kamaraj**, popularly known as Kamarajar was an Indian independence activist and politician, who served as the Chief Minister of Madras State from 13th April 1954 to 2nd October 1963.
 
• **Subramaniya Siva** was an Indian freedom fighter, writer, and pure Tamil movement activist during the Indian Independence Movement.
